info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Servicing Mandate Management API
info.description: The Servicing Mandate Management API enables businesses to initiate and manage servicing mandates efficiently. Through this endpoint, users can create new servicing mandates that define the authorization for specific banking operations on customer accounts. Typical consumers include financial institutions and banking service providers looking to streamline mandate establishment processes. This API facilitates seamless integration into banking workflows, ensuring compliance and enhancing operational efficiency.

post.description: This endpoint allows for the creation of a new servicing mandate, which outlines the terms and conditions for service provisions. Ensure to provide all required details in the request body.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to create or update a servicing mandate. It requires a payload in JSON format that adheres to the defined schema, ensuring all necessary data is provided to successfully process the mandate.
